lines.text: You clicked I agree in under one second!

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: That's forty pages. You didn't read one word.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: Reading every privacy policy you accept takes seventy-six work days a year.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Fine. I'll read it. Clause nine: they can rename your dog.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Clause forty-seven: they get your firstborn child!

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: Only on weekends. Read the fine print.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Wait. How do you know the fine print without reading it?
